n1a12c8fc78.why: Defense contractors depend on government contracts for missile and weapons programs, so their capacity expansions reflect defense spending trends.

nb2e881bcfc.headline: Baghdad Accuses Tehran, Washington of ‘Strangling’ the Iraqi Economy
nb2e881bcfc.summary: Iraq's government spokesman accused Iran and the United States of strangling Iraq's economy. He said neither had granted exemptions allowing Iraqi oil exports through the Strait of Hormuz.
nb2e881bcfc.why: Iraq is a major oil exporter whose crude shipments depend on the Strait of Hormuz, so restrictions there affect its government revenue and global oil supply.

n9aee2b45df.summary: Global fertilizer inventories and ongoing USMCA trade talks are adding uncertainty to the fertilizer market before spring planting. The input gives no further detail on prices or volumes.
